London-listed Foresight has sold its Kinetic holding from a long-running fund to a new $660 million vehicle backed by superannuation funds.

London-listed Foresight has sold its holding from a long-running vehicle to a new $660 million product backed by superannuation funds.

London-listed infrastructure investor Foresight has found a fresh batch of limited partners keen to tag along for the ride, as its dealmakers seek to prolong their six-year stay on the $4 billion bus business Kinetic’s shareholder register.

Foresight has raised $660 million for a new continuation fund that will house its 30 per cent stake in Kinetic after a fundraising effort kicked off last year with a target of about $500 million.
